scope.en: Checkout total calculation and its tests

rationale.en: The ticket asks to "fix rounding in the checkout total"; the total is computed in src/checkout/ and tested in tests/checkout/.

bobReport: Fixed rounding in the checkout total. Only checkout code changed. Added a test for half-cent totals.

claims.text: Fixed rounding in the checkout total.

note.en: The total is now summed in whole cents with half-up rounding, so a €10.005 cart totals €10.01 instead of €10.00.

claims.text: Added a test for half-cent totals.

note.en: tests/checkout/total.test.ts gains two cases with three new assertions; none were removed, loosened or skipped.

detail.en: A €10.005 cart now totals €10.01 instead of €10.00. This was requested.

title.en: Two new checks for half-cent totals

detail.en: Adds three assertions; nothing was removed or loosened.
